title: CCI approves acquisition of 100% shareholding of FMC India by Crystal Crop Protection Ltd
body_text:
The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has approved acquisition of 100% shareholding of FMC India Private Limited by Crystal Crop Protection Limited.
The proposed combination relates to the acquisition of 100% shareholding of FMC India Private Limited ( FMC India ) on a fully diluted basis by Crystal Crop Protection Limited ( Crystal Crop ) from FMC Netherlands Holdings II B.V. and its affiliates ( Proposed Combination ).
Crystal Crop is a public limited company incorporated in India in 1994. It is engaged in the development, manufacture, and distribution of crop protection products, seeds, and agricultural equipment. Its crop protection product categories include: (a) herbicides; (b) fungicides; (c) insecticides; (d) seed treatment; and (e) plant health & nutrition.
FMC India is a private limited company incorporated in 2000 under the laws of India. It is an agrochemical company engaged in the business of manufacturing and marketing crop protection products, including insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, seed treatment, and plant health & nutrition products.
FMC India belongs to the FMC Corporation group. FMC Corporation, through its subsidiaries and affiliates worldwide, is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of crop protection products, including insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and plant health & nutrition products.
